title: 英伟达员工：三成身家2000万美元，黄仁勋走后还留吗
speaker: Stacey Rasgon

segments.en: Um, I wonder about some of the partnerships that Jensen had a really strong hand in putting in place and you're going to get some new CEO at some point.
segments.zh: 我有点怀疑Jensen深度参与建立的一些合作关系，而且你迟早会迎来新的CEO。

segments.en: And will they have a similar view on those partnerships? I don't know. I wonder about the employees, you know, I, what were some of the numbers?
segments.zh: 他们对这些合作关系会有类似看法吗？我不知道。我也在想员工的情况，那些数字是多少来着？

segments.en: You, I, I can't even remember 30% of the employees or something have a net worth of, you know, $20 million or more.
segments.zh: 我甚至记不清了，大概30%的员工净资产达到2000万美元或更多。

segments.en: And she got all these folks there who have lots of money and don't need to work who are there because they're working with Jensen and like, what happens to that?
segments.zh: 那里有一群很有钱、不需要工作的人，他们留在那里是因为和Jensen共事，那这种情况会怎样？

segments.en: Like when Jensen's not there anymore, like, dude, do they continue to stick around? Like, I, I don't know.
segments.zh: 当Jensen不再在那里时，他们还会继续留下来吗？我不知道。

segments.en: So there were things that things could happen as you're thinking forward.
segments.zh: 所以展望未来，有些事情可能会发生。

segments.en: And it's, it's hard to know like what, what things are going to look like.
segments.zh: 很难知道情况会变成什么样。
